title: Sparse plus low-rank matrix embedding with applications in cancer radiotherapy optimization
summary: Decomposing a matrix into sparse and low-rank components is central to robust principal component analysis and has broad applications in machine learning, signal processing, and computer vision. Classical formulations seek to recover the underlying sparse and low-rank structure. We instead introduce \emph{sparse-plus-low-rank matrix embedding} (SLME), whose goal is to construct a computationally efficient surrogate for a large dense matrix, without requiring its components to be interpretable.
